description: Versioned adaptation of the AlphaGenome ENCODE audit policy for categorical SCREEN immune-cell annotations.

source.article: Advancing regulatory variant effect prediction with AlphaGenome

adaptation_notes: AlphaGenome uses quantitative ENCODE tracks and may rescue some ChIP experiments using FRiP. SCREEN supplies categorical cCRE calls without a harmonized FRiP value, so this preparation does not perform FRiP rescue.
The policy is applied to every ENCODE experiment contributing to a retained SCREEN biosample profile. It never rewrites the original 448-column SCREEN matrix.
This audit policy controls the curated baseline-primary-cell view only. Excluded profiles remain available in the complete source layer with their exclusion reasons.
